# Test fixture provenance

`oriented-jpeg.base64` is an original 8 × 5 solid-colour JPEG created for this repository with EXIF orientation 6. It is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.

The remaining codec fixtures are generated in memory from solid colours and are likewise CC0-1.0.

`tiny-heic.base64` is an original 4 × 3 solid-colour HEIC generated for this repository and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
